scholarships.title: SUTD Trailblazers Scholarship
scholarships.official_source: Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD)

existing.funding_period: per academic year (S$3,000 per academic term)
existing.description: The SUTD Trailblazers Scholarship is a leadership-and-merit award for applicants to SUTD bachelor's degree programmes, described by SUTD as one that 'empowers high-performing students who exhibit outstanding potential to lead and make an impact'. It covers subsidised tuition fees after the Tuition Grant for up to four years, adds an annual allowance of S$6,000 (S$3,000 per academic term), and provides a travel award of up to S$5,000 for approved overseas programmes. No bond is attached, but the recipient must take up the Tuition Grant Scheme. SUTD lists it as a SUTD-administered scholarship new in AY2025.
eligibility: Singapore Citizen applying for admission to SUTD's undergraduate degree programme
Outstanding Singapore-Cambridge GCE A Level, Local Polytechnic Diploma, NUS High School Diploma, IB Diploma or Year 12 equivalent qualifications
Demonstrate strong leadership capabilities and potential
Possess an excellent record in co-curricular and/or community activities
Have the attitude, desire, and potential to make an impact on society
existing.eligibility_summary: Open to Singapore Citizens applying for admission to an SUTD undergraduate degree programme with outstanding Singapore-Cambridge GCE A Level, Local Polytechnic Diploma, NUS High School Diploma, IB Diploma or Year 12 equivalent qualifications, strong leadership capability and potential, an excellent co-curricular and community record, and the attitude to make an impact on society.
benefits: Subsidised tuition fees (after Tuition Grant) for up to four years
Annual allowance of S$6,000 (S$3,000 per academic term)
Priority consideration for the Global Exchange Programme (GEXP)
Travel award of up to S$5,000 for approved overseas programmes
Priority opportunities for leadership development through Fifth Row groups such as the University Ambassador Club
coverage: Subsidised tuition fees after the Tuition Grant for up to four years
Annual allowance of S$6,000 (S$3,000 per academic term)
Travel award of up to S$5,000 for approved overseas programmes
requirements: Maintain good academic standing; academic performance reviewed every term
Complete at least 20 hours of service to the University, e.g. as a student ambassador
Do not hold concurrent scholarships or grants without University approval
existing.english_requirement: model to generate a design structure matrix in less than five minutes.
application_method: Apply for admission to SUTD and indicate interest in applying for the SUTD scholarships in the admission application
existing.selection_notes: Scholarships are awarded based on competition among eligible applicants. SUTD reserves the right not to award any scholarship if there are no candidates of sufficient merit, and the decision of the selection committee is final.
existing.best_fit: Singapore Citizen school leavers with top academic results plus a strong leadership and community record applying to an SUTD bachelor degree programme.
existing.notes: A separate SUTD Trailblazers (International) Scholarship exists for Singapore Permanent Residents and International Students and covers subsidised tuition fees only, with no annual allowance or travel award. It is a different award from this record.
existing.duration: Up to four years (the normal duration of the relevant SUTD bachelor degree programme)
existing.application_period: Annual, tied to the SUTD undergraduate admissions cycle. Listed by SUTD as 'new in AY2025', so it is offered every intake.
existing.deadline_display: There is no separate scholarship deadline. SUTD states 'Application for the scholarships is made at the same time as application for admission to SUTD', and the published 2026 admissions application window ran 2 January to 2 March 2026 for most qualifications, and from the release of A-Level results to 19 March 2026 for Singapore-Cambridge GCE A-Level qualification.
existing.program_type: Leadership and academic merit scholarship for new undergraduate admission applicants

scholarships.title: Short Term Scholarships Administered by NTU

existing.funding_period: per academic year (one academic year tenure)
existing.description: Short Term Scholarships Administered by NTU is a pool of donor-funded scholarships for current undergraduates or freshmen at NTU who are on subsidised tuition fees, have performed well academically and meet the criteria specified by the donor. Award values range from S$3,000 to S$16,000 and each scholarship is tenable for one academic year. A single online application covers the whole pool; applicants are considered for the best scholarship they qualify for. Some awards are need-based and require income documentation, and depending on the donor recipients may be required to intern at the donor organisation.
eligibility: Current undergraduate or freshman at NTU on subsidised tuition fees
Performed well academically and met the criteria specified by the donor of the scholarship
Must not be holding any other scholarship
Must not be on Leave of Absence (LOA)
Need-based scholarships additionally require ID and income supporting documents
existing.eligibility_summary: For current undergraduates or freshmen at NTU who are on subsidised tuition fees, have performed well academically and meet the criteria specified by the donor of the scholarship. Awardees must not be holding any other scholarship and must not be on Leave of Absence. Singapore Citizens, Permanent Residents and International Students are all covered by the page's nationality filters.
benefits: Award value ranges from S$3,000 to S$16,000 depending on the specific donor scholarship
coverage: Partial award valued between S$3,000 and S$16,000 depending on the donor scholarship, tenable for one academic year
requirements: Scholarships that are need-based will require supporting documents such as ID and income documents to be submitted during the application process.
Depending on the donor, scholarship recipients may be required to intern at the donor’s organisation.
documents: Completed NTU Document Checklist for need-based scholarship consideration
Separate bursary application in the same year for additional financial support
application_method: Apply online during the 1 to 31 July application window
Freshmen must apply two days after matriculating online
Submit the Document Checklist with family ID and income documents in a single uploaded document if seeking need-based scholarships
Submit a separate bursary application in the same year if additional financial support is needed
Attend the scholarship interview if shortlisted
existing.selection_notes: Applicants are considered for the best scholarship available based on award eligibility criteria, merit and, where the donor specifies, willingness to undertake an internship and financial need. Applicants must indicate interest 'Yes' for internship and/or 'All Short Term Scholarships including needs-based scholarships' in the application. Only shortlisted applicants are informed by email by end-September to attend interviews. Rejecting the invitation, failing to supply requested information, or being absent means the application is deemed withdrawn.
existing.best_fit: NTU undergraduates or incoming freshmen on subsidised tuition fees with strong academic performance who can evidence co-curricular or financial need and, where relevant, are willing to intern with a donor.
existing.notes: This is an internal NTU award for students already enrolled or about to enrol at NTU; it is not an inbound scholarship for overseas students. Related NTU scholarships listed on the page include the NTU President Award, CN Yang Scholars Programme Scholarship, NBS Global Leaders Programme Scholarship, NTU-University Scholars Programme (NTU-USP) Scholarship and the Renaissance Engineering Programme Scholarship (REPS).
existing.application_period: Annual window of 1 July to 31 July for the AY26-27 intake. Shortlisted applicants are notified by email by end-September, and interviews take place from August to early October.
existing.deadline_display: NTU states 'Application for AY26-27 will open from 1 July to 31 July 2026.' That AY26-27 window has already closed, so the next window is expected in the same July period but no dated calendar is published.
existing.program_type: Donor-funded merit and need-based undergraduate scholarship pool
